title: A GIS and ML-Based Land Parcel Valuation System for Decision Support: Konya Province, Türkiye

creators.name: Shalaby, Magd

description: CME434 Geographic Information Systems, Karabük University. Supervisor: Dr. Öğr. Üyesi Sohaib K. M. Abujayyab. Spatially cross-validated Konya land asking-price analysis and an offline-capable Python Web GIS. The release includes reproducible code, local Sentinel-2 and terrain layers exported from Google Earth Engine, OSM accessibility features, a trained XGBoost model and a reduced public listing schema. Study results are guidance only.
